messages.subject: PR6 safety review complete: execution remains blocked
messages.body: Completed the independent source-only closure, resolver, full-diff and A–G review in the two named artifacts (Markdown SHA256 8477e7a86161a2fbbe98e8d2093314c1328f2ebef3424e8ff94031e7754ebd6d; JSON SHA256 c3a5079fd174e38904fcd6eb97ca8fa3844d12ba60135568819b581c97c3f325). All 197 listed historical objects match, but the actual closure omits the original peer stub, and seven findings cover completion synchronization/progress, swallowed async errors, default-queue destruction, incomplete init admission, native vocabulary bounds and startup null handling. Main must keep the route source-only, resolve the recorded blockers and host gates, then exclusively own any build, diagnostic, failure, quality, performance, physical256K and RESTORE execution.
